facts.fact: TechCabal quotes IPSL chief Gituku Kirika on 18 November 2026 saying PesaLink, integrated with PAPSS, now lets people send money into Kenya from other PAPSS-enabled countries, and that international money transfer operators use it for last-mile delivery.
TechCabal quotes IPSL chief Gituku Kirika on 18 November 2026 saying PesaLink is integrated with the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System.
